environment: local Windows Chromium; fresh isolated contexts against root-path final build
commands: npx vitest run tests/m11-ui-values.test.ts tests/m11-hierarchy-editor.test.ts tests/m11-examples.test.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=.test-generated/m11-ui-after-fit-fix.json

tests.title: M11 controlled instances open active definitions, save versions, reload, and retain exact source models
M11 execution mode changes retain data connections and expose real control ports and settings
M11 newly grouped diagrams edit boundary aliases and execute real ForEach partitions
M11 independent state and enable hold/reset examples compute different actual state banks
M11 for/while loops expose automatic boundaries, bounded drafts, and zero-call initial output
M11 nested bus editor preserves exact typed leaves, rejects invalid drafts, and escapes payload text
M11 message queue exposes previous-tick batches and exact payloads in history CSV and TS downloads
M11 structured forms and result trees stay readable at 320px and 200% text in both themes

failures: Three genuine hidden child-canvas failures after hierarchy entry. hierarchyView returned a new view model on every store-render, resetting React Flow measurements.
One test read the debounced persisted model too early.
corrections: Memoize hierarchyView by rootModel and hierarchyPath; re-arm the measured fit effect on navigation instead of fitting an unmeasured view.
Poll the actual persisted model before asserting execution mode and connections.

assertions: all input/select/textarea controls contained in their form
theme changed through the actual UI button

contract: Controlled references and compile-selected Variant open the correct child canvas; actual nodes are visible and editable.
Child edits advance the selected version and survive local save, reload, model download and import.
New ForEach grouped boundaries can be renamed without losing connections and compute actual [6,9] outputs.
Independent instance state and enabled hold/reset have distinct actual literal results.
For/While automatic boundaries and bounded repeat drafts are backed by compiler/runtime outputs.
Structured JSON keeps quoted int/fixed codes exact; invalid drafts do not commit and block execution; markup stays escaped.
Message previous-tick empty batches, producer metadata and exact payloads appear in result samples and downloaded history/CSV/TS source.
Actual standalone generated TS execution and source coverage approval are root gates, not implied by download tests.
limitations: All native/source options remain open; the 48 new definitions do not imply 73 full native mechanisms.
Variant selection is fixed before a run; dynamic switching within a run is unsupported.
Hierarchy diagnostics currently carry paths in the compiler/runtime but the editor click handler only selects nodeId in the current canvas.
Feedback-latch initialDescriptor uses the generic text editor and compiler validation.

screenshots.observation: Large text and JSON editor remain inside the field; help wraps at the field width; black/gray theme contrast is preserved.
